decisions.reason: Specifying the document destination for CRM Task 1 does not change the existing deadline for completing scheduled assignments.
The CRM artifact destination does not change the fallback rule for independently starting other available work.
The instruction to complete CRM Task 1 in its document does not change how completed tasks are marked in ClickUp.
The impact is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY setting the completion location to the designated Google document and adding Google Drive to its components.
